title: DataNepal dataset catalog entry
description: Provenance metadata required for every published dataset. A published aggregate with no stated source, licence, or vintage is not citable, and citability is what makes the platform useful rather than merely interesting.

table.description: Name of the table in the marts schema.

description.description: What the dataset contains and what it does not.

name.description: Publishing body, e.g. Central Bureau of Statistics.

licence.description: Licence of the underlying data, or 'unknown' if the source states none. Do not guess.

vintage.description: Reference period of the data, e.g. '2021' or '2025-11'. Distinct from when we fetched it.

caveats.description: Known limitations a good-faith user needs in order to not misread the data.

contains_personal_data.description: Must be false for anything published. Present as an explicit assertion rather than an assumption.
